verdict.rationale: HMRC is a government tax authority whose core product is the statutory administration of tax registration, filing and accounts. Self-hosting that service is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence suggests HMRC ships any self-hostable distribution. The evidence covers only online services, the HMRC app and the hosted Making Tax Digital API platform, none of which make the self-hosting axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
